The solid line is around 14 in the mid-1950s, but the description places this value specifically at 1956 without support from the plot's exact point positions.
The solid line's second major peak is around 1967–1968 and is near 49, not specifically 1966.
The line drops to around 2 in the early 1970s, but the exact year 1972 is not the point of the low shown in the figure.
The plotted value around 1978 is closer to 8–9, so 10 is slightly overstated.

The dotted trend line peaks around the mid-1950s near 30, but 1952 is still below the peak and the trend does not show two separate 30-value points at 1950 and 1952.
The dotted line is around 15 in the early 1960s, but the exact year 1960 is approximate rather than clearly identifiable from the plot.
The dotted line is around 10 in the late 1960s/early 1970s, but the exact year 1970 is approximate.
The dotted line is around 5 in the early 1980s, but the exact year 1980 is approximate.
The dotted line is already near 2 before 1990 and continues declining toward 0 afterward; assigning 2 specifically to 1990 is not supported.
